articles.headline: Lionel Messi breaks record for most World Cup goals after Austria double
articles.description: Lionel Messi became the highest goal scorer in men's World Cup history Monday, moving up to 18 with a superb double in Argentina's Group J match against Austria.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Messi makes history with 17th and 18th World Cup goals
articles.description: It's another week of 2026 FIFA World Cup action, and we have some big teams playing today, including Argentina, France and Norway.

articles.headline: Senegal's Pape Thiaw: Federation's non-payment, admin issues resolved, a matter of 'principle and respect'
articles.description: Senegal head coach Pape Thiaw has criticised his federation's handling of administrative issues related to his own contract and the payment of players' bonuses during the ongoing World Cup.

articles.headline: Resolving the Jordan Ayew dilemma and other areas of focus for Ghana vs. England
articles.description: Ghana and England have met only once before at senior level - a 1-1 friendly draw at Wembley in March 2011. Tuesday's match marks their first competitive meeting.

articles.headline: Is Tunisia's World Cup campaign Africa's worst ever, as Herve Renard magic fails?
articles.description: Herve Renard warned, before taking the reins in his first match as Tunisia coach, against Japan on Saturday, that there were 'no magicians in football'.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi bag two WC records as Argentina beat Austria
articles.description: Lionel Messi set a World Cup record with his 17th and 18th goals, and defending champion Argentina advanced to the knockout stage with a 2-0 victory over Austria on Monday.
